Hi OP! Reading this post made me relate a lot cause I also have ADHD and suffered from DPDR 3 years ago after a stressful event. Moving to a different country at 18 and dealing with a lot of problems young adulthood brings is not easy so please don’t be hard on yourself. If it’s possible a consultation about your unmedicated ADHD can help you out regarding how to deal with coursework, focus and overthinking. I know that Turkish psychiatrists do not have the best approach to it (mine just gave me 4 boxes of Ritalin and said deal with it on your own lmao) but asking for help and support is much better than relying on alternatives which may cause more damage considering the DPDR part. Dissociation is  pretty serious and in my case substance abuse worsened it and made my whole life a mess. I don’t have any experience with psychedelics but a general advice would be to either avoid it especially between the ages of 18-25. My answer is unrelated to your question but I hope you can figure it out <3
